name: Bug Grinder
source:
Zuri, left without any options, signs up to be put into cryosleep so that one day she will be defrosted and used as a mech pilot. She quickly finds out that being a pilot for these biological mechs is a lot more than she bargained for.

[From [url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/bug-grinder]itch.io[/url]]
